label: Window Silhouette
description: The most tasteful boudoir formula: a solo figure as silhouette against blown window light — implied, elegant, gallery-safe.
prefix: A fine-art boudoir silhouette photograph — the figure reduced to a single elegant line against a wall of glowing window light, everything sensual carried by shape and restraint alone.
suffix: Silhouette Rendering: (the body's outline rendered as one continuous elegant line:1.25), window light blooming around the edges, interior detail dissolved to darkness, sensuality entirely implied — a print for a gallery wall.
